$note: Machine-readable realization ledger for the Unity game-pause-menu lane. Generated components are consumed through public exports only; every region below the generated surface is a ledgered fallback so a later package admission can swap it mechanically. Update this file and the README ledger together. SCOPE: this ledger measures the Unity target's 7-component allowlist at slice base dddf4ee6b; a parallel package-side workstream has since expanded the Unity target to 48 components on main, and the 'swap' fields name the generated controls that can replace these fallbacks in a follow-on pass.
